description: Go service owning the product catalog, per-shopper cart, checkout orchestration, and orders for the ceramics store. Persists data in an embedded SQLite database. Exposes a single REST API consumed by both ceramics-storefront (shopper flows) and ceramics-admin (seller/catalog/order-management flows). Resolves the caller's role (shopper vs seller) from the gateway-injected X-User-Groups header and scopes cart/order data to the caller's own X-User-Id for shoppers. Re-validates stock at order placement, snapshots line-item price/name onto the order so later catalog edits never change a past order, decrements stock only after successful payment, and calls the payment provider and email provider to complete checkout. Does not implement its own authentication endpoints — Thunder issues tokens and the platform gateway validates them.
